description: User-facing entry names for the review Flows: the four core stage entries from #2016 and the four upstream review entries from #2017. The entry name is what a person types or asks for; the Flow id and version are what the judgment is recorded against. This document carries no host vocabulary on purpose: how an entry is surfaced belongs to agents/contracts/adapter-map.json, and which Flow it resolves to belongs here, so the two hosts have nothing to disagree about.

review-plan.description: Can execution safely start from this plan?

review-replan.description: Is this plan change justified and does it leave the upstream contract intact?

review-task.description: Is there evidence to declare this task DONE?

review-final.description: Are the goal and requirements met, rather than merely every task closed?

review-research.description: May this research result be used as the ground for requirements, design and plan?

review-requirements.description: May design and implementation proceed from these requirements?

review-design.description: May implementation proceed from this design?

review-technical.description: Do the declared technical premises hold on the evidence supplied?

task-checkpoint.description: The executor is about to declare a Task DONE, or a person asks for a checkpoint. Resolves to the task-completion entry; the required evidence is the Flow's own required inputs.

artifact-ready.description: An upstream artifact (research, requirements, design, technical premises, plan, revised plan) became reviewable. Which of the listed entries applies is decided by the artifact kind; the required evidence is therefore the selected Flow's required inputs, not fixed here.

before-publish.description: The change is about to be published for others (a pull request is created, updated or marked ready). Resolves to the final entry.

before-merge.description: The final checkpoint before a merge decision. Same entry as before-publish, but the review run must be execution-isolated from the implementation run; a result that does not meet that tier is supporting evidence only. The merge decision itself stays with the hosting platform and the human.

after-change.description: One or more edits settled into a stable change set. Starts no Flow: only the deterministic fast-verification profile applies, scoped to the changed files. The empty entries list is the declaration, not an omission.
